items.meaning: Let's go. What we yell over the radio when the convoy rolls out.
Your crew. The friends you would call to pull you out of a ditch at 2 AM.
The village carrying a house together. On the trail, it means group recovery.
Eating with your hands, family style. Utensils are optional at camp.
A feast laid out on banana leaves. Everyone dives in at once.
See you there. You get this text after you RSVP.
A gathering over food. The real reason anyone shows up.
Take care. Said at the end of every trip, and we mean it.
